reference_artboards.usage: Native-pixel measurement and frozen visual comparison only; do not scale the full-page PNG as production UI.

coordinate_and_unit_contract.browser_simulator_unit: CSS px at 1 CSS px = 1 dp for deterministic layout simulation
coordinate_and_unit_contract.content_origin: top-left of the inset-safe content box
coordinate_and_unit_contract.outer_viewport_orientation: follows the actual available viewport; no page-specific forced rotation is specified
coordinate_and_unit_contract.p03_capture_direction: landscape capture-phone instruction and horizontal fish imagery are internal teaching content only; they do not rotate the outer UI

candidate_tuning_values.reason: Values below are proposed responsive implementation parameters, not measurements recovered from the frozen artwork.
candidate_tuning_values.explanation: The example grid uses three columns when available content width can fit three 112dp cards and two 8dp gaps; narrower widths wrap to two columns. The 320dp profile retains two columns and vertical page scrolling.

layout_algorithm: Read the current viewport and WindowInsets; never infer outer-page rotation from P03 capture-phone orientation.
Compute safe width and height from the viewport after subtracting system-bar insets.
Lay out masthead/back action, hero, intro copy, three error examples, completion hint, pagination, and action row in that order using a vertical flow; text and control rows use intrinsic height.
Keep the Hero image aspect ratio and use contain/ContentScale.Fit so the complete fish remains visible. Do not rotate horizontal or vertical source photos.

Set error examples to three equal columns when content width after 16dp horizontal page padding is at least 352dp (384dp safe width); otherwise wrap to two equal columns, with the final item on its own row when needed.
Allow titles, support text, labels, and actions to wrap. Never ellipsize or clip required teaching copy.
Keep interactive targets at or above 48dp in each dimension. Action rows may wrap while preserving Skip, Previous, and Primary action reachability.

Use natural content height. On short viewports, allow vertical scrolling through the complete content; never pin a footer over content. On tall viewports, retain content order and distribute surplus only into flexible photo/section spacing within the declared maximums.
Apply the selected font scale to text sizes and line boxes. Text containers grow naturally; no viewport profile may hide text or actions.
acceptance_invariants: No horizontal overflow in the page or workspace viewport.
All required copy remains fully visible and wraps rather than truncates.
No overlap between vertically flowing content groups.
All controls meet the 48dp candidate target and remain reachable by scrolling.
All photo candidates load from independent manifest paths and preserve source orientation/aspect ratio.
P03 landscape capture direction never changes the outer simulator viewport orientation.

verification_boundary.browser_simulation: Runs the registered viewport × font-scale matrix in Chromium and records overflow, text bounds, button targets, image load, orientation, scroll reachability, and selected page.
verification_boundary.native_android_runtime: NOT_RUN; browser simulation does not establish Android WindowInsets, IME, lifecycle, capture, or runtime acceptance.
verification_boundary.frozen_pixel_parity: NOT_CLAIMED; workspace preview is a responsive design proposal, not a re-render of the frozen source layers.
